description: Create a different silhouette of the SAME short ruined limestone column on its stepped square plinth. The shaft is worn low with an irregular scalloped fracture, a missing front-right wedge, and one small rear jagged tooth. Keep its exact native pixel density, oblique top-down projection, weathered pale gray limestone and muted moss, light from upper-left. PRESERVE original stepped plinth and support pixels in rows40..53 unchanged. Only change the short shaft above that, fractured upper edge, stone joints and cracks. Transparent48x56 canvas; clear margins, two clear bottom gutter rows; no detached rubble, plant or cast shadow. Same scale and same object.
